items.headline: Baylor bounces back, wins Joe Klanderman's first game as interim coach
items.description: In Joe Klanderman's first game as interim coach, Baylor routed UCF 41-9, a convincing Bears' victory that snapped the Knights' four-game home winning streak.

items.headline: Lagway throws for 4 TDs as Baylor wins Klanderman's first game as interim coach, beating UCF 41-9
items.description: — DJ Lagway threw for 319 yards and four touchdowns to lead Baylor to a 41-9 rout of UCF on Friday night in Joe Klanderman's first game as interim head coach.

items.headline: Robert Griffin III says he is '100 percent' interested in Baylor coaching job
